scheme_name: Cash Grant in lieu of Sewing Machine
other_conditions: Applicant must be the widow of an ex‑serviceman
Applicant must be registered with the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry

The scheme also applies to living spouses/widows of ex‑servicemen who are re‑employed as regular or deemed‑regular in government, public sector undertakings, private organizations, or are self‑employed
benefits_summary: A cash grant of ₹10,000 is provided for the purchase of a sewing machine, transferred to the beneficiary’s bank account via RTGS/NEFT.
documents_required: Copies of mandatory documents (self‑attested, if required)
